title: Luna Access & Security System V1
status: REFERENCE / CONCEPTUAL / SIMULATED — security/access zoning unresolved (DD13)

intercomOutOfScope.reason: door_release capability remains unmapped — a pre-existing, deliberate architectural decision predating this phase, not reversed here

newCanonicalAssetsJustification: none created — the Master Equipment Schedule's own 'Current instance register' already documents every access-related asset this phase needed; the three common points' real capabilities are 'observable; none' and were NOT upgraded, since doing so would fabricate backend data

accessStateModel.physicalState: AccessPointState.locked: boolean | null — real boolean for the governed lock, honest null for uninstrumented common points
accessStateModel.authorizationResult: AccessAuthorizationResult { granted, reason, role } — computed fresh per attempt, never stored, strictly separate from physical state
accessStateModel.doorMotionStatesReason: no real lock/unlock capability data supports OPENING/OPEN/CLOSING/CLOSED for this reference chain — 'do not blindly implement every state'
accessStateModel.faultStateReason: no fault scenario is wired for the governed lock in this reference build

authorization.identityModel: reuses the existing RepresentationIdentity shape (role + assignedHomeRefs) as the credential — no new identity/credential database
authorization.publicRoleReuse: the pre-existing 'public' role (data-model placeholder before this phase) stands in for Visitor/Unauthorized
rules: ungoverned ref (any of the 3 common points) -> always denied, honest DESIGN DECISION REQUIRED reason
facility role at the private lock -> denied, no master-key capability modeled (mirrors HVAC's own resident-only precedent)
resident role, assignedHomeRefs includes the lock's unitRef -> granted
public role or missing identity -> denied, never fails open
authorization.wiredInto: execute() in lunaSimulationProvider.ts, the same real choke point every command already passes through — protects the runtime regardless of which UI/Oyi path reaches it

accessEventLog.convention: identical shape/cap/order to FireEvent/ElectricalEvent, same notify()/subscribe() pub-sub

equipment: AccessReaderPanelGeometry — wall/post-mounted control panel with card-reader face + status LED, used for the three common access points
AccessLockKeypadGeometry — compact wall keypad/plate whose LED reflects the governed lock's own real locked state (green=locked, amber=unlocked)
physicalGeometry.doorLeafGeometry: none exists anywhere in the codebase (InteriorRoom's doorSide only cuts a wall opening) — a disclosed geometry gap, not fabricated
physicalGeometry.dispatch: ACCESS_EQUIPMENT_KIND by-exact-ref table in OperationalAssetLayer.tsx, same pattern as Water/Electrical/Fire/HVAC equipment

controlBoard.summaryWidget: AccessStatusSummary — reused headerContent? slot, dom hooks [data-access-status-summary]
controlBoard.privateLockExcluded: Apartment 6A's own lock is deliberately NOT a board tab — HIDDEN to Facility, same disclosed boundary as HVAC's indoor units; stays operable via the existing interior device-interaction surface

oyiIntelligence.newMatcher: matchAccessStatus in lunaIntentParser.ts, inserted after matchHvacStatus
newVocabulary: LUNA-GROUND-ACCESS-MAIN-01 aliases (main resident entrance, the main entrance, main entrance, main gate, residential entrance, building entrance, the lobby entrance, lobby entrance)
LUNA-B1-ACCESS-SERVICE-01 aliases (service entrance, the service entrance, b1 service entrance)
LUNA-GROUND-ACCESS-LIFT-LOBBY-01 aliases (lift lobby access, the lift lobby access point)
oyiIntelligence.collisionCheck: every new pattern checked against the full existing FACILITY_ASSET_ALIASES list and every other system's own target-phrase list for substring collisions before being added — proactively re-verified in scripts/verifyAccess.mjs (Electrical's 'active power path' and HVAC's 'turn on the AC'/'is the AC running' phrases re-tested and confirmed unaffected)
targetPhrasesVerified: Show me the last access attempt.
oyiIntelligence.honestRefusal: the two imperative phrases naming uncontrollable common points ('Open the main gate.', 'Lock the lobby entrance.') resolve to a command intent and are then honestly refused by the PRE-EXISTING generic capability check in execute() — no access-specific fabrication code was needed

representationPolicy.commonAccessPoints: FULL_3D for Facility — ordinary common infrastructure, unchanged pre-existing rule

governedLock.auditConclusion: resolveAssetMode()'s resident-HIDDEN-for-common-infrastructure rule is consistent, pre-existing, intentional behavior already established identically for Water/Electrical/Fire/HVAC — not a defect, no change made

safetyBoundaries: no lock/door capability was fabricated for the three common access points — they remain observable; none, matching the real backend schedule
the one governed lock keeps its exact pre-existing lock/unlock capability — no open/close/door-motion command was fabricated
Facility is denied master-key authority at the private lock — no such capability is documented anywhere in the canonical catalog
no security certification, biometric technology, credential technology, lock manufacturer, or encryption standard was claimed anywhere

tests.browser: scripts/verifyAccessBrowser.mjs — including all required screenshots and Elevator/Water/Electrical/Fire/HVAC regression

unresolvedDesignDecisions.DD13: Security and access zoning — credential technology, lock manufacturer/model, encryption standard, statutory compliance, parking gate, door-leaf hardware for the three common points, and any CCTV correlation.
